subject: POC kickoff coordination — aligning owners, success criteria, and calendar windows
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reeve <areeve@blueford.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nsharma@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff — proposed dates and owners

Alex —

Thanks again for the quick discovery yesterday. To keep momentum, we'd like to lock a 90–120 minute POC kickoff with your engineering, procurement and security partners present. The goal is to align on success criteria, timeline, and owners so the POC can start first week of October if possible.

Proposed windows (all 90–120 min):
- Tue, Oct 5 — 10:00–12:00 PT
- Thu, Oct 7 — 14:00–16:00 PT
- Wed, Oct 13 — 09:00–11:00 PT (backup)

Suggested attendees (we'll add calendar invites once you confirm):
- Marissa Cole — AE (product/contract owner)
- Nikhil Sharma — Solutions Lead (technical owner)
- Soojin Lee — SE (demo & environment setup)
- Blueford platform & procurement representatives
- Security Ops (for SOC 2 / data handling Q&A)

I've attached a one-page POC success criteria and a mutual action plan template to accelerate the meeting. If those look good I can pre-fill the MAP and share before the call.

Thanks — what window works best for your group?

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Marissa mobile: +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: POC-success-criteria.pdf (1 page), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (stub)
From: Alex Reeve <areeve@blueford.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@blueford.com>, Security Ops <security@blueford.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nsharma@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — proposed dates and owners

Hi Marissa / team —

Thanks, and appreciate the templates. A couple quick notes from our side:
- Procurement: our approval window is tight the week of Oct 4–8; lead buyer is only available Oct 6 after 2pm ET.
- Security: we need to review SOC 2 evidence and a brief data-handling checklist before committing engineering time. They can join the kickoff but may ask to follow up with a deeper review.
- Engineering: we can free up two engineers for a 90-minute kickoff but prefer sessions earlier in the day ET.

Given that, can you offer a couple of morning ET slots the week of Oct 4? If procurement can only do Oct 6 after 2pm ET that blocks some of that week — we may need to split the invite (kickoff + separate procurement sign-off) if those calendars can't align.

Also, please send any SOC 2 / retention notes you have so our security folks can triage before the call.

Alex Reeve
Director, Platform Engineering — Blueford Systems
areeve@blueford.com
From: Nikhil Sharma <nsharma@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reeve <areeve@blueford.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@blueford.com>, Security Ops <security@blueford.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2026 14:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — proposed dates and owners

Alex —

Thanks for the clarity. Quick plan to reduce back-and-forth:
1) Proposed canonical kickoff (all parties): Wed, Oct 13 10:00–12:00 ET (90–120 min). If Procurement can only do Oct 6 after 2pm ET we can do a shorter procurement alignment session week of Oct 4–8 and still run the full POC kickoff on Oct 13 (gives security time to review docs).
2) Success criteria (pre-populated below and in attached PDF):
   - Stable inference throughput for 1,000 concurrent sessions (baseline test run)
   - Latency < 250ms p50 on 512 token prompts for shared model configuration
   - Data isolation: all request logs retained per agreed retention window and encryption at rest verified
   - Integration of auth flow (API key or mTLS) validated with one sample request
3) Owners:
   - Redwood technical owner: Soojin Lee (SE)
   - Customer technical owner: Alex Reeve
   - Procurement / commercial: Marissa Cole (contracts) + Blueford procurement (procurement@blueford.com)
   - Security lead: Security Ops (security@blueford.com)

Attachments: POC-success-criteria.pdf (filled draft), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (starter MAP)

If that plan works I will:
- Send a calendar invite for Oct 13 and a short invite for procurement on Oct 6 if they confirm availability
- Share SOC 2 summary (redacted) and a short data-retention note for Security to review before the kickoff
- Post the MAP to the shared Drive link below for comment

Draft calendar + MAP link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=mutual-action-plan-1147
DocuSign SOW (where applicable): https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC-1147

Would appreciate a thumbs up from Procurement and Security on the plan — if procurement confirms Oct 6 we’ll create the split invites.

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma | Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reeve <areeve@blueford.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nsharma@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — proposed dates and owners

Alex / team —

A few technical notes so the kickoff is productive:
- Environment: we need temporary access to a staging endpoint or example dataset of ~10k tokens so we can validate tokenization and latency. If you can share a one-off API key or host a small test collection, that would speed things up.
- Network: if you have IP allowlist constraints please send the CIDR or allowlist window for Oct 13 (I’ll coordinate infra).
- Time estimate: I’ll allocate 90 minutes for walkthrough + 30 minutes for hands-on validation. If Procurement needs only a commercial check-in on Oct 6 we can keep that to 30 minutes.

I’ll pre-load the MAP with the technical checklist and expected post-kickoff runbook items.

Soojin
Soojin Lee | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

For the fuller technical kickoff, Oct 13 10:00 ET works — please send calendar invites and the brief SOC 2 summary you referenced.
